records.portable.json: portable_check.sh: the portable loops' instructions under clang and gcc against the tree before's prevalidated entries, every one but the alignment padding and GCC's endbr64; GCC's kernel A/B at its default loop alignment and with loops aligned to 32 bytes, in both link orders
records.kernels-b444807.json: the kernel A/B on Q8-LANES' first commit (b444807) against the tree before: its portable instance slower than the tree before's loops, which the second commit fixes -- made by this directory's q8_ab.c from the first run of measure_lanes.sh, whose form then named the tree before HEAD~1 and had no portable step
records.decode-b444807.json: the decode A/B of that first run: its portable arm (a build capped at 1, the vector code dropped) holding 1
records.kernels.json: q8_ab.c: each kernel at the 860K decoder's shapes and at TinyLlama-sized ones, the tree before's unit (its entry points renamed) against the tree after's on each instance and an A/A control, one process, clang and gcc; every output the tree before's bytes
records.decode.json: decode_ab.py: the standalone C decoder (bcir-llama) built from each tree -- the tree after at its widest instance, capped at AVX2 and at the portable loops -- against the tree before's and an A/A control, 24 rounds, clang and gcc; every run's tokens and final logits the tree before's bytes
records.ops.json: llama_ops.py: the monolithic decoder's step an operation at a time on each tree (clang, 200 tokens, the median of 5 runs)
records.bits.json: bits.sh: the decoder's tokens and final logits from 7 builds of the tree after (clang and gcc at each instance cap, clang with the dispatch compiled out) against the tree before's, 2 models x 3 prompts x 4 lengths
records.qualification.json: qual_summary.py over run_qualification.py --require-callgrind from each tree on the lab model: latency, the logits' agreement, the simulated cache rows, every check
records.faults.json: red_sweep.py: q8-lanes.json on the tree after, and again on the witnesses before Q8-LANES (without_the_cases.py): which faults only the new witnesses catch
records.explore.json: NEXT-5 on the tree before: the step's pool jobs, the GEMMs', the attention's and the loss's rates, LOSS-MAX's prototype, with the commands that ran
records.hashes.json: the committed tools' and the measured sources' sha256
records.the tools: measure_lanes.sh (the records' run) and the instruments it ran -- q8_ab.c, decode_ab.py, llama_ops.py, bits.sh, qual_summary.py, without_the_cases.py -- the bytes that ran; the script's host paths as placeholders (<REPO>, <SCRATCH>, <LAB>, <LAB2>), which filled in are the run copy byte for byte

verdicts: each effect resolved where its 95% interval excludes 1 and does not meet the A/A control's
